pages: {"text": "Tidewell log. The sea cools the draught lines from the gatehouses. The guardians tolerate us if we keep to the lit halls."}
{"text": "Water in the cooling halls has gone dark. Not dirty. Dark, like the black seep from below, thinned out in brine.\n\nFish will not enter the halls."}
{"text": "Order from the Guild: hold the Tidewell at any cost.\n\nThe cost was decided for us. The great one woke. The halls are flooded by my hand. Nothing more will be cooled here."}
{"text": "If the gatehouses still run, they run hot. If they run hot, they leak.\n\nI am sorry for what the sea will carry. L.M."}
